ns2:course.label: Undergraduate Seminar
ns2:course.description: Group discussion on a special topic in a field of study directly pertaining to subject matter in food science and human nutrition. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated in the same or subsequent terms to a maximum of 12 hours. Prerequisite: Sophomore standing.
